purpose: Researcher-facing decision presentation (WU-12). PURE re-shaping of the WU-11 decision brief; measures nothing new; selects/scores/ranks/recommends no formulation; researcher_selection stays null.

action_space.pump_strategy: SPEED only, re-issued each step; native STATUS rules intact

normalization_constants_frozen.note: FIXED constants measured once (baseline reference run / this analysis) and frozen; NOT per-episode running statistics -> no train/eval leakage. deficit_ref guards against a ~0 baseline deficit by taking max(baseline mean, pooled p95).

formulation_families.name: normalized_weighted_sum
formulation_families.sign_convention: reward is a NEGATIVE cost; higher (less negative) is better
formulation_families.clipping: unserved clipped at >=0; da=0 for static holds
formulation_families.epsilon_handling: all denominators are fixed nonzero constants

formulation_families.name: constrained_penalty_service_protected
formulation_families.sign_convention: reward is a NEGATIVE cost; higher (less negative) is better

formulation_families.name: baseline_relative_improvement
formulation_families.sign_convention: reward is a NEGATIVE cost; higher (less negative) is better
formulation_families.expression: r_t = (leak_ref - leak_t)/leak_ref - w_U*max(0, unserved_t - unserved_ref)/req_ref - w_P_safety*(deficit_t/deficit_ref)

formulation_families.name: safety_first_lexicographic
formulation_families.sign_convention: reward is a NEGATIVE cost; higher (less negative) is better
formulation_families.expression: if min_svc_p_t < 0: r_t = -c_hard - deficit_t/deficit_ref; elif min_svc_p_t < theta: r_t = -c_soft - deficit_t/deficit_ref; else: r_t = -(leak_t/leak_ref) - eps*(||da_t||^2/L2sq_max)
formulation_families.clipping: branch selection by min service pressure vs threshold
formulation_families.epsilon_handling: fixed nonzero denominators; eps effort tie-break

candidate_formulations.equation: r_t = - w_L*(leak_t/leak_ref) - w_U*(unserved_t^+/req_ref) - w_P*(deficit_t/deficit_ref) - w_A*(||da_t||^2/L2sq_max) - w_E*(power_t/power_ref)
candidate_formulations.scale_derivation: All four active terms are pre-normalised to O(1) by the FROZEN WU-9 constants, so unit weights are the neutral starting point. w_A=0.1 is read from WU-10 pathology C: the leak-term dynamic range across in-bounds commands is ~0.108, while one max-movement step costs 1.0 at w_A=1; scaling w_A to ~0.1 keeps a full-swing action step commensurate with (not dominating) the measured leakage signal. w_E=0 keeps the (optional, hydraulic-only) energy term out to avoid parameter proliferation.

plain_language_fa.q1_encourages: کاهش همزمان نشت، کاهش تقاضای برآورده‌نشده (unserved) و کاهش کسری فشار (deficit)، به‌علاوه‌ی یک جریمه‌ی کوچک برای تغییرِ زیادِ عملگرها. هر چهار ترم با ثابت‌های ثابت‌شده‌ی WU-9 نرمال شده‌اند تا هم‌مقیاس باشند و وزن‌های ۱ نقطه‌ی شروعِ خنثی‌اند.
plain_language_fa.q2_leak_down_service_down: چون نشت و سرویس و فشار هر سه وزنِ ۱ دارند، بهبودِ نشت با بدترشدنِ سرویس و افزایش deficit خنثی یا حتی منفی می‌شود؛ پاداش لزوماً بهتر نمی‌شود.
plain_language_fa.q3_pressure_up: طبق شواهد (leak↔pressure)، بالا رفتنِ فشار نشت را زیاد می‌کند پس ترمِ نشت بدتر می‌شود، هرچند deficit و unserved بهتر می‌شوند؛ نتیجه‌ی خالص به تعادلِ وزن‌ها بستگی دارد.
plain_language_fa.q4_action_moves_a_lot: ترمِ w_A*(‖Δa‖²/28) با w_A=0.1 یک جریمه‌ی کوچک می‌گیرد؛ یک حرکتِ کاملِ کران‌به‌کران تقریباً هم‌اندازه‌ی کلِ دامنه‌ی تغییرِ نشت (~0.108) هزینه دارد، نه بیشتر.

candidate_formulations.actuator_effort_role: w_A*(||da||^2 / 28) on the COMMANDED normalised action (never realised pump speed); w_A=0.1.
candidate_formulations.service_pressure_treatment: dense normalised pressure_deficit term (deficit/deficit_ref) with w_P=1, plus unserved^+ term with w_U=1; NO hard threshold term.
candidate_formulations.leakage_treatment: normalised absolute leakage leak/leak_ref with w_L=1.
candidate_formulations.special_cases: unserved clipped at >=0; da=0 for static holds; all denominators are fixed nonzero constants; energy term off (w_E=0).

evidence.observed: Balanced leakage/service/safety/effort; but WU-10 induced-incentive argmax under unit weights is prv_176_upper and the leak-only optimum sits at the PRV lower corner (OBSERVED) -> a STEP-9 clamp is required, not optional.
evidence.unresolved_risk: WU-10 F1_vary_w_P shows w_P=0 -> prv_175_lower; w_P>=0.5 -> prv_176_upper. w_P below ~0.5 lets the incentive drift toward the low-pressure corner.
evidence.validation_experiment: After the STEP-9 clamp exists: short deterministic PPO smoke test to confirm the per-step reward is non-flat and finite; measure realised ||da||^2 to replace the analytic effort ceiling (HYPOTHESIS).

candidate_formulations.scale_derivation: Identical to C-A except w_P=2.0. Motivated by the measured deficit<->leak correlation -0.7735 and the dense worst-node min-pressure signal (WU-9): a heavier normalised deficit weight more strongly protects worst-node pressure. w_P=2 is still O(1) after normalisation.

plain_language_fa.q1_encourages: همان C-A است ولی وزنِ فشار/deficit دو برابر (w_P=2) است؛ یعنی محافظت از بدترین گرهِ فشار پررنگ‌تر می‌شود. این فقط «تأکیدِ متفاوت» است، نه رتبه‌بندی نسبت به C-A.
plain_language_fa.q2_leak_down_service_down: چون وزنِ deficit بزرگ‌تر است، بدترشدنِ سرویس شدیدتر جریمه می‌شود؛ پس بهبودِ نشت به‌قیمتِ سرویس، پاداش را بیشتر از C-A پایین می‌آورد.
plain_language_fa.q3_pressure_up: مثل C-A نشت بالا می‌رود و ترمِ نشت بدتر می‌شود؛ اما چون deficit وزنِ ۲ دارد، بهبودِ فشار سهمِ مثبتِ بزرگ‌تری می‌گذارد.
plain_language_fa.q4_action_moves_a_lot: دقیقاً مثل C-A: جریمه‌ی کوچکِ w_A=0.1 روی ‖Δa‖²/28.

candidate_formulations.actuator_effort_role: identical to C-A: w_A*(||da||^2 / 28) on COMMANDED action; w_A=0.1.
candidate_formulations.service_pressure_treatment: same dense deficit term as C-A but with heavier weight w_P=2 (still O(1) after normalisation); unserved^+ with w_U=1; NO hard threshold.
candidate_formulations.leakage_treatment: normalised absolute leakage leak/leak_ref with w_L=1.
candidate_formulations.special_cases: same as C-A (unserved^+ clipped; da=0 static; fixed denominators; w_E=0). Only difference vs C-A is w_P: 1 -> 2.

evidence.observed: More weight on pressure safety may reduce achievable leakage cuts; this is a different emphasis, NOT a ranking versus C-A.
evidence.inferred: dense, differentiable; a safety-leaning emphasis of C-A (INFERRED).
evidence.unresolved_risk: Over-weighting deficit could flatten the leakage gradient (leak span ~+/-6%).
evidence.validation_experiment: Same smoke test as C-A; compare realised min-pressure margin.

candidate_formulations.equation: r_t = (leak_ref - leak_t)/leak_ref - w_U*max(0, unserved_t - unserved_ref)/req_ref - w_P_safety*(deficit_t/deficit_ref)
candidate_formulations.scale_derivation: Leakage improvement term is intrinsically normalised (fraction of baseline leakage) and zero-centred at the native controller, so no leak weight is needed. unserved_ref is the baseline unserved implied by DSR=0.98334 (~15.10 GPM; the WU-9 accounting value is 14.985 GPM). w_P_safety=1 uses the FROZEN deficit_ref. WU-10 F3 sweep: w_P_safety=0 -> prv_175_lower/prv_lower_pump_lower; w_P_safety>=1 -> prv_176_upper, so keep w_P_safety>=1.

plain_language_fa.q1_encourages: پاداش برابرِ «کسرِ کاهشِ نشت نسبت به کنترلرِ بومی» است، منهای جریمه برای unserved اضافه‌تر از خطِ پایه و جریمه‌ی deficit. یعنی مستقیماً «بهبود نسبت به baseline» را تشویق می‌کند و در نقطه‌ی کنترلرِ بومی صفر است.
plain_language_fa.q2_leak_down_service_down: اگر unserved از سطحِ baseline (~15.10 GPM) بیشتر شود جریمه می‌گیرد و ترمِ deficit هم جریمه دارد؛ پس بدترشدنِ سرویس، سودِ کاهشِ نشت را جبران/خنثی می‌کند.
plain_language_fa.q3_pressure_up: بالا رفتنِ فشار نشت را زیاد می‌کند، پس ترمِ بهبودِ نشت ((leak_ref-leak)/leak_ref) کوچک یا منفی می‌شود.
plain_language_fa.q4_action_moves_a_lot: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE — خانواده‌ی F3 در منبع هیچ ترمِ حرکت/هموارسازیِ عملگر ندارد؛ تغییرِ زیادِ action مستقیماً جریمه نمی‌شود.

candidate_formulations.actuator_effort_role: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE (F3 family defines no actuator-movement / smoothness term).
candidate_formulations.service_pressure_treatment: excess-unserved penalty w_U*max(0, unserved - unserved_ref)/req_ref (only ABOVE baseline) plus dense deficit term w_P_safety*(deficit/deficit_ref).
candidate_formulations.leakage_treatment: fractional improvement vs native baseline (leak_ref - leak)/leak_ref; intrinsically normalised, zero-centred at the native controller; no separate leak weight.
candidate_formulations.special_cases: excess unserved clipped at >=0; unserved_ref = 15.103309701248634 GPM (DSR-implied baseline; the WU-9 accounting value is 14.98483697365873 GPM); NO hard threshold term.

evidence.observed: Directly answers the thesis objective (reduction vs baseline) but the leakage improvement dynamic range is small (~+/-6%), so signal-to-noise must be checked.
evidence.inferred: interpretable as % leakage reduction vs native baseline (INFERRED).
evidence.unresolved_risk: Small reward magnitude may need reward/advantage scaling at training time.
evidence.validation_experiment: Smoke test: confirm advantage estimates are non-degenerate.

candidate_formulations.equation: r_t = -(leak_t/leak_ref) - LAMBDA*(deficit_t/deficit_ref) - BIG*max(0, n_negative_t)   # hard term on NEGATIVE nodes only
candidate_formulations.scale_derivation: Explicitly REPLACES the F2 hard n_below_20 term with the dense deficit term, because WU-10 pathology F/G show the 20-psi count fires on the native baseline itself (frac_ts_any_node_below_20psi = 1.0) -> a hard 20-psi term is ill-posed on this network. The hard term is retained ONLY on NEGATIVE nodes (baseline count 0, frac_negative=0.0) so it is well-posed and fires only if a control drives a node sub-zero. LAMBDA=5 keeps the normalised deficit term within ~1 order of magnitude of the O(1) leak term (deficit_ref-normalised); it is a central value in [1,10], not fitted.

plain_language_fa.q1_encourages: کاهشِ نشت و کاهشِ deficit (سرویس)، با یک «دروازه‌ی سختِ» جریمه فقط برای فشارِ منفی. عمداً ترمِ سختِ «۲۰ psi» حذف شده چون روی خطِ پایه هم فعال می‌شود (ill-posed).
plain_language_fa.q2_leak_down_service_down: ترمِ deficit با وزنِ LAMBDA=5 جریمه می‌شود، پس بدترشدنِ سرویس پاداش را پایین می‌آورد؛ و اگر کنترلی گره‌ای را به فشارِ منفی ببرد جریمه‌ی بزرگِ BIG=100 فعال می‌شود.
plain_language_fa.q3_pressure_up: نشت بالا می‌رود پس ترمِ نشت (leak/leak_ref) بدتر می‌شود؛ ترمِ منفیِ سخت فعال نمی‌شود.
plain_language_fa.q4_action_moves_a_lot: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE — این نسخه هیچ ترمِ حرکت/هموارسازی ندارد؛ تغییرِ زیادِ action مستقیماً جریمه نمی‌شود.

candidate_formulations.actuator_effort_role: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE (this dense-safety variant defines no actuator-movement term).
candidate_formulations.service_pressure_treatment: dense normalised deficit term LAMBDA*(deficit/deficit_ref) (LAMBDA=5) PLUS a hard gate BIG*max(0, n_negative) firing ONLY on negative-pressure nodes (baseline count 0).
candidate_formulations.leakage_treatment: normalised absolute leakage leak/leak_ref (unit implicit weight).
candidate_formulations.special_cases: REPLACES the ill-posed hard 20-psi count with dense deficit; hard term keyed on NEGATIVE nodes only (well-posed, baseline frac_negative=0.0); the 20-psi level appears only inside the smooth deficit = sum max(0, 20 - p_i), NOT as a hard gate.

evidence.observed: Avoids the ill-posed 20-psi penalty; but LAMBDA is unmeasured and sets the leakage/service exchange rate, which the researcher must choose.
evidence.inferred: service protected by construction with a well-posed hard backstop (INFERRED).
evidence.unresolved_risk: WU-10 F2 lambda/big sweep argmax is stable at prv_176_upper (incentive direction robust) but reward MAGNITUDE is untuned; a very large LAMBDA suppresses the leakage gradient.
evidence.validation_experiment: Smoke test with STEP-9 clamp active; confirm the negative-node hard term never fires in-bounds and only activates on genuine violations.

tradeoffs.central_tradeoff_fa: چرا یک reward که با موفقیت نشت را کم می‌کند می‌تواند از نظر علمی برای این تز غلط باشد؟ شواهدِ اندازه‌گیری‌شده‌ی BWSN-1 نشان می‌دهد نشت و سرویس واقعاً در تضادند: هم‌بستگیِ leak<->dsr برابر +0.7497 و leak<->deficit برابر -0.7735 است، و بهینه‌ی «فقط-نشت» دقیقاً روی کرانِ پایینِ PRV می‌نشیند (prv_all_lower: نشت 84.73->81.38 GPM ولی dsr 0.98334->0.91940). یعنی یک reward که فقط نشت را می‌بیند، agent را به سمتِ پایین‌آوردنِ فشار می‌راند و سرویس را خراب می‌کند در حالی‌که عددِ نشت بهتر به‌نظر می‌رسد. افزون بر این، شبکه به‌طور مزمن در هر گامِ زمانی حداقل یک گرهِ سرویس زیرِ ۲۰ psi دارد (frac_ts_any_node_below_20psi = 1.0؛ min svc 4.16452 psi) ولی هیچ گرهِ منفی ندارد؛ پس یک قیدِ سختِ مطلقِ ۲۰ psi روی خودِ خطِ پایه هم فعال می‌شود و بد-تعریف است.
tradeoffs.layer_separation_fa: به همین دلیل «طراحیِ reward» (D-P6-005) و «مکانیزمِ ایمنیِ وابسته به وضعیت» (STEP-9) دو لایه‌ی جدا هستند: reward فقط رفتار را شکل می‌دهد و هیچ کرانِ فشاری را تضمین نمی‌کند؛ تضمینِ اجراییِ ۲۰ psi کارِ کلمپِ سطحِ اجرا در STEP-9 است. هیچ‌کدام از این دو لایه در این وظیفه پیاده‌سازی نمی‌شود.

decision_dimensions.leakage_management_signal: All candidates carry a leakage term; F1 family (C-A/C-B) and C-D use absolute normalised leak, F3 (C-C) uses fractional reduction vs baseline. Measured in-bounds leak span is small (~+/-6%, dynamic range ~0.108 across tested commands).
decision_dimensions.service_preservation: C-A/C-B/C-D protect service via a dense deficit term; C-C penalises unserved above baseline. Measured leak<->dsr +0.7497 and leak<->deficit -0.7735 show service and leakage genuinely oppose.
decision_dimensions.pressure_safety_signal_density: Dense channels (deficit, min-service-pressure) are active every timestep; the <0 psi hard channel is inactive in-bounds (frac_negative 0.0) and the <20 psi count is active at 100% of timesteps INCLUDING the native baseline.
decision_dimensions.signal_density_dense_vs_sparse: C-A/C-B/C-C/C-D rely on dense terms. Any hard-count term is sparse or (at 20 psi) degenerate on this network.
decision_dimensions.scale_stability_fixed_normalisation: Every candidate divides by the FROZEN WU-9 constants (leak_ref, req_ref, deficit_ref, movement_L2sq_max), so terms are O(1); raw penalty magnitudes otherwise span a ~7.15x ratio.
decision_dimensions.interpretability_thesis_explainability: C-C is directly interpretable as % leakage reduction vs the native controller; C-A/C-B as a normalised weighted cost; C-D as leak+dense-service with a negative-pressure backstop.
decision_dimensions.parameter_count_and_sensitivity: C-A/C-B expose {w_L,w_U,w_P,w_A} (w_E=0); C-C exposes {w_U,w_P_safety}; C-D exposes {LAMBDA,BIG}. Sweeps show the incentive-argmax shifts with these parameters (e.g. F1 w_P 0 -> prv_175_lower, >=0.5 -> prv_176_upper).
decision_dimensions.reward_hacking_resistance: Effort/smoothness MUST use the COMMANDED action (realised pump speed is reset by native STATUS rules); a hard 20-psi term is ill-posed; an F4-style 0-psi threshold never fires yet reports 'safe'.
decision_dimensions.ppo_continuous_action_compatibility: All candidates are finite and (for the dense F1/F3 forms) smooth/differentiable; F2/F4-style large penalties give high-variance returns (F2 pooled reward std ~42 vs F1 ~0.17).
decision_dimensions.step9_safety_layer_compatibility: No candidate enforces a pressure bound; the leak optimum sits on the PRV lower corner, so a STEP-9 state-dependent clamp is required regardless of the reward chosen. C-D's negative-node gate is complementary to, not a substitute for, STEP-9.
decision_dimensions.reproducibility_no_leakage: All constants are fixed (measured once, frozen), not per-episode running statistics; reference reproduces the frozen baseline exactly (leak_ref abs diff 0.0, per-timestep vs accounting 0.0).
decision_dimensions.baseline_relatability: C-C is zero-centred at the native controller (baseline-relative); C-A/C-B/C-D are absolute-cost forms whose values are read relative to the measured reference.

measured_grounding.leak_only_optimum: prv_all_lower: leak 84.73->81.38 GPM, dsr 0.98334->0.91940 (boundary-seeking at PRV lower corner)

uncertainties: Realised actuator-movement distribution is unknown (static runs = 0 movement); effort scale is analytic -> HYPOTHESIS until a policy trajectory exists.
Leakage is a VALIDATION instrument, not field-calibrated; only RELATIVE response is meaningful.
Joint 5-D in-box safety is characterised at a single lower corner only; interior/mixed corners are a STEP-9/STEP-12 job.
Reward weights / LAMBDA / thresholds set leakage<->service exchange rates that are value judgements for the researcher, not measured quantities.
Pump power is HYDRAULIC only (no efficiency curve); energy term optional.

reproducibility.deterministic: EPANET deterministic; no RNG; no seed
